label: Town of Wallingford
header:
# Town of Wallingford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists only Carolyn Behrendt and Katherine Luzader of Wallingford's five-member board

Town of Wallingford, Elected and Appointed Officers page (wallingfordvt.com): Anne Awad, Rob Barker, Carolyn Behrendt, Kathy Luzader (Chair), and Glenn Mayer (Vice Chair). The directory's 'Katherine Luzader' is the Chair's formal variant; the town's own page and the roster of record read Kathy Luzader
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Jill Stone-Teer as Wallingford's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Jill Stone-Teer as Wallingford's Town Clerk
Town of Wallingford, Elected and Appointed Officers page (wallingfordvt.com): 'Town Clerk, Jill Stone Teer' (the page drops the hyphen; the Guide's form governs)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Jill Stone-Teer as Wallingford's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Jill Stone-Teer as Wallingford's Town Treasurer
Town of Wallingford, Elected and Appointed Officers page (wallingfordvt.com): 'Town Moderator, Tammy Heffernan'
Town of Wallingford, Elected and Appointed Officers page (wallingfordvt.com): 'Auditors: Maureen Duchesne, Chelsey LaRock and Karen Smith'
